item.title: Nikeia #3886 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius))
item.description: Nikeia #3886 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
